# Packages for every Arch machine. Edit by hand.
# GPU drivers (nvidia/intel) and kernel headers are added automatically by install.sh.
# Boot/kernel/filesystem bits (grub, snapper, linux, ...) come from archinstall, not here.
# pkglist-<host>.txt is the auto-generated snapshot of what's actually installed:
# diff against it to find packages worth promoting into this list.

# shell + cli
zsh
zsh-autosuggestions
zsh-completions
zsh-syntax-highlighting
starship
zoxide
eza
trash-cli
less
neovim
git
github-cli
stow
pacman-contrib
tailscale

# desktop
niri
xwayland-satellite
xdg-desktop-portal-gnome
xdg-desktop-portal-gtk
greetd
matugen
qt6ct
inter-font
ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd
qt6-multimedia-ffmpeg
cava
alacritty

# audio
pipewire
pipewire-alsa
pipewire-jack
pipewire-pulse
gst-plugin-pipewire
libpulse
wireplumber

# hardware + services
networkmanager
bluez
bluez-utils
power-profiles-daemon
